name: Lesson 3: Using clues to choose correct verb form
descriptionHtml:
1. Question type

In this section, you are asked to select the correct verb form to fill in the blank by using the clues in the sentence and the passage. 

 

2. Guide to answer

- Based on signals in the question as well as the rest of the text to choose the correct form. For example, signals of the present continuous tense are words like “now”, “at present”, “at the moment”, etc or signals of the present perfect tense are words and phrases like “since + the point of time”, “for + the amount of time”, “ever”, etc.
